source: Local examination of user-supplied screen recording and app archive; no video upload
findings: Transient lens/scene change called pause() and disabled analysis
Warm yellow felt was fragmented by the green threshold
Large close round balls exceeded component size limits
Twenty historical events referenced tiny 2–6 px signals; 14 REVIEW and 6 UNMARKED
Custom FLOOR settings had no floor boundary; an IN polygon does not itself prove floor contact
Old session events were redrawn after opening a different camera view

cropCheck.input: Two unmodified preview crops from compressed screen video, 210x366 pixels; UI marks still present
cropCheck.knownCenters: Manually inspected approximate centres; not original sensor ground truth
cropCheck.limitations: Two examples only; no real-match accuracy or speed conclusion

modelType: Deterministic colour, geometry, motion and scene-consistency rules; no trained neural model replaced
